formats: Open a mailbox export from Gmail, Thunderbird, or Apple Mail.
privacy: Your mailbox stays on your device.
invalid: No MBOX messages found. If you downloaded a ZIP file, extract it first and open the MBOX file inside.
choose: Select a message to read it.
messageError: This message could not be read. You can still open other messages in the mailbox.
resourceLimit: Your browser ran out of resources while opening this email. Close other tabs and try again.
noBody: This email has no readable message body. Its available headers and attachments are shown above.
protected: This email is encrypted or protected. Decrypt it in your email application before opening it here.
